propositions: Closing a ticket calls _compact_on_close which acquires and holds the store write lock for the entire compaction fold (read, reduce, snapshot write, retire, git operations), measured at up to 13m53s, blocking concurrent agent writes
Compaction is optional housekeeping for correctness and already has a skip-path; removing it from the close tail restores lock holds to seconds-scale acquisitions
The store lock hold during close is unbounded because _compact_locked timeout/attempts only constrain acquisition not retention, and nested git locks stack budgets inside the held store lock
Deleting _compact_on_close and its call site removes the only production caller of write_lock_is_busy but does not remove that API function or break its test suite
After removing compact-on-close, ticket event logs remain unfolded and larger on disk until out-of-band compaction runs, but the stored state and reduction behavior are unchanged
